'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Michael Klimenko LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Klimenko]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
